Name: (CP) Character Portrait Overhauls
Author: Temiser
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*]After running the game once you will have a file called "config.json" inside Stardew Valley/Mods/[CP] Character Portrait Overhauls. 
[*]To disable Bachelors' portraits set "IncludeBachelors" to "false".
[*]To disable Bachelorettes' portraits set "IncludeBachelorettes" to "false"
[*]To disable Robin, Caroline, Lewis and Linus set "IncludeOthers" to "false"
[*]To use the more rounded version of Abigail's portrait set "AbigailPortrait" to "Rounder"
[*]To use the bearded or shaved versions of Harvey's portrait set "HarveyPortrait" to "Bearded" or "Shaved" respectively
[/list]
